references.text: Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Judah in the census.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, was the first to bring his offering at the dedication of the altar.
The banner of the tribe of Judah set out first when the Israelites broke camp, led by Nahshon, son of Amminadab.
Jacob's blessing over Judah foretells the tribe's leadership role, fulfilled as Judah encamped first to the east.
Nahshon is mentioned in David's genealogy through the book of Ruth.
Nahshon, son of Amminadab, is listed among the descendants of Judah in 1 Chronicles.
Nahshon is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy in the Gospel of Matthew.
Nahshon is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy in the Gospel of Luke.
